description: 388 was a Separatist B2-HA super battle droid who crashed on the planet Koboh aboard the Lucrehulk-class battleship Primacy before being found and reprogrammed by the Bedlam Raiders along with the rest of the core ship's complement. In 9 BBY, 388 argued with fellow B2-HA droid 459 in the Primacy's wreckage about which of them was superior.
